project_type: Single-file PWA 'Forma' (index.html, vanilla JS, localStorage state S, GitHub Pages) plus older sibling gymapp.html and sw.js service worker
language: JavaScript (inline in HTML), Node ESM for dev tests
build_system: None. Static files. Dev tests in tools/*.test.mjs run with node. tools/build-info.test.mjs checks BUILD_VER/BUILD_TS in index.html and gymapp.html equal sw.js CACHE.
test_framework: plain node + node:assert tests, each run as `node tools/<name>.test.mjs`. tools/fin-extract.mjs shows the preferred approach: slice REAL functions/consts out of index.html by name and eval via new Function (fn(name) finds '\nfunction name(' ; konst(name) matches '^const name=...$' single line). tools/workout-snapshot.test.mjs mirrors functions verbatim instead.
build_command: bash /projects/sandbox/_h/chk.sh   (node --check sw.js and extracted inline scripts of index.html and gymapp.html)
test_command: for f in tools/*.test.mjs; do node $f || exit 1; done
verification_instructions: chk.sh syntax check, all tools/*.test.mjs, then render harness in /projects/sandbox/_h (see g.mjs / h*.mjs: loads index.html main script with stubbed DOM via run(state, now), sample state /projects/sandbox/forma-backup-3dias.json, personal data, keep out of repo). Render Weekly volume + Recovery cards EN and ES, assert no 'undefined'/'NaN'.
environment_constraints: No real Android browser. Harness is Node stub DOM only. Commit locally on main, do not push, no PRs. Leave .kiro/ untracked/uncommitted. Never use em dashes in written content.
contribution_requirements: Always update both index.html and gymapp.html (where feasible) and sw.js CACHE (forma-v104 -> forma-v105) plus BUILD_VER and BUILD_TS (real current UTC) in both HTML files. UI English; ES via translation dictionary (big object near end of file, keys are exact EN strings) and `R` regex list (const R=[[/regex/,'repl $1'],...]) for strings with numbers.
key_patterns:
Existing gym model in index.html: S.gym.plan (plan), gPlan(), gday(i)->[{e,j}], gnm(i,j,e) resolved name, gMethod(name) 'micro'|'myo'|inc, gsets(e), gdl() deload state S.gym.dl={s,e} (manual: action data-a=gdlon starts a 7 day deload, gdloff ends; S.gym.dle = last deload end), gses()/gstat()/galert()/rcv() stalling and recovery alerts (rcv: 7 day avg of S.slp <6.5h or S.str >=3.5 is poor), muscleOf(name)->{p,s} using MMAP (exact names) then MRX (regex), MUSG 13 keys (chest,lats,upper back,front delts,side delts,rear delts,biceps,triceps,quads,hamstrings,glutes,calves,abs), MUSL ES labels, gMuscleSets() planned weekly sets (myo = fixed 3 primary / 1.5 secondary, compound k==H 0.5 secondary, isolation none), gMuscleSummary()/gMuscleState()/MBAND in the plan config screen (bands 10-18 / 8-16, keep unchanged), moodSummary for S.journal {date:{mood 1..5}}, S.str[date] stress 1..5, S.slp[date] hours, S.nap. Log: S.gym.wl['YYYY-MM-DD#ts']={d,t,ex:{name:[[w,reps,rir]...]},warm,prime:{name:[w,reps]} (myo activation),dl?,sn:{t,u,items:[{j,n,p,e:{k,s,..}}]}}. Myo lift: ex[name] holds the mini-sets (rir usually 0), prime[name] the activation set. Gym view render at index.html ~line 3832 ('

📊 Gym stats

' card inside $('#gout').innerHTML); click dispatcher handles data-a actions around lines 4860-4880 (e.g. gdlon, gwcp). Week starts Monday.
directory_structure: repo root: index.html, gymapp.html, sw.js, manifest, icons; tools/ dev tests; .agents/tasks/ task state; .kiro/ (do not commit)
